title.en: An Act Establishing A High School in Barangay Cabudian in the Municipality of Duenas, Province of Iloilo, To Be Known As the Cabudian High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing A High School in Barangay Cabudian in the Municipality of Duenas, Province of Iloilo, To Be Known As the Cabudian High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông tại Barangay Cabudian tại Thị trấn Duenas, Tỉnh Iloilo được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông Cabudian
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาในบารังไกย์ Cabudian ในเทศบาล Duenas, จังหวัด Iloilo ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Cabudian
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas di Barangay Cabudian di Kotamadya Duenas, Provinsi Iloilo dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Cabudian
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah di Barangay Cabudian di Perbandaran Duenas, Wilayah Iloilo dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Cabudian

text.en: There shall be established a high school in Barangay Cabudian in the Municipality of Duenas, Province of Iloilo, to be known as the Cabudian High School.
The Secretary of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
The amount necessary for the implementation of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
